source_snapshot.items: UFM Telemetry TMS setup and trial run - Run IB-Stress
source_snapshot.procedure: Assign 10.10.10.1/16 to node-1 ibp79s0f0 and 10.10.10.2/16 to node-2 ibp206s0; run `ib_write_bw` server on mlx5_4 and client on mlx5_10 at port 11000 with `--report_gbits --run_infinitely`; inspect Telemetry.
source_snapshot.criteria: UFM panels show correct information, network status matches the nodes and the configured time window is recorded correctly.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL/CONFLICTING; gives only generic UFM access and attaches unrelated subnet-merger risk, omitting address, device and unbounded-worker safety.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CHANGED; requires exact identity mapping, isolated address scope, finite supervision, telemetry correlation and rollback.

old_problem: The active review left the case pending for node/device mapping, traffic duration and telemetry tolerance. Perftest documents the peer roles, fixed-duration mode and that `--run_infinitely` runs until interrupted; the source's 20-minute allocation supplies a safe complete duration. Remaining identities and correlation tolerance are runtime project bindings.
disposition_reason: Official perftest supports fixed `-D` duration and Gbit/s output, and requires matching peer versions/options. The source's 20-minute machine time can preserve workload coverage while replacing indefinite execution with 1200 seconds plus a watchdog. NVIDIA UFM defines port bandwidth telemetry and time-series windows. ED-03 permits identity/IP/tolerance bindings, ED-05 isolates IB from Ethernet, ED-14 preserves the full duration, and ED-16 gates network mutation and recovery. No new engineering decision is needed.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row421 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3013 and adjacent row420 view plus row422 cable-validation cases.
Applied linux-rdma perftest semantics: server/client roles, matching versions/options, `--report_gbits`, fixed-duration `-D` and unbounded `--run_infinitely` behavior.
Mapped the source's 20-minute allocation to a complete 1200-second supervised run rather than a shortened smoke test.
Preserved both source IPs, netdevs, mlx5 devices and TCP control port subject to direct port/GID/route/collision verification and exact restoration.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row422 and verified its manifest identity; no address change, bandwidth worker, UFM query or DUT/fabric action ran.

test_case.test_name: Reversible 20-minute two-node IB write load and UFM telemetry correlation
test_case.purpose: Generate a controlled 20-minute RDMA-write stream over the exact approved InfiniBand path and prove UFM records the same port status, bandwidth trend and configured time interval as synchronized endpoint evidence.
required_package: Same pinned perftest/rdma-core/OFED version on both nodes and approved UFM Telemetry view from row420
Node serial/host identities plus verified ibp79s0f0↔mlx5_4 and ibp206s0↔mlx5_10 port/GID/peer/cable mapping
Collision-free isolated 10.10.10.0/16 test scope, approved routes/PKey/SL/MTU and alternate management access
Approved endpoint-to-UFM metric/unit/sample interval, timestamp skew and numeric correlation tolerance, 1200-second window and network rollback
test_case.test_command: Capture node/netdev/HCA/port/GID/route/address/link/counter prestate and prove 10.10.10.1/16 plus 10.10.10.2/16 are isolated and unused. Add the two addresses without replacing management configuration. Start synchronized UFM/endpoint counter capture. Run matching pinned peers for the complete 1200 seconds: server `ib_write_bw -d mlx5_4 --report_gbits -p 11000 -D 1200` and client `ib_write_bw -d mlx5_10 10.10.10.1 --report_gbits -p 11000 -D 1200`, both under a 1200-second-plus-grace external watchdog. Preserve outputs/status, stop both peers, remove only added addresses/routes and verify exact prestate restoration.
test_case.expected_result: Both mapped peers negotiate and complete the 1200-second RDMA-write run with successful statuses and no link/RAS/error event. UFM identifies the same ports and operational state, shows traffic rise/run/return in the configured window and matches endpoint rate/counter deltas within the approved sampling/unit tolerance. Network state returns exactly to baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires verified identities, collision-free reversible address changes, full 1200-second peer evidence, successful termination, synchronized endpoint/UFM values within the approved tolerance, correct UFM time window and exact cleanup. A populated panel, unbounded leftover process, shortened run, wrong port or missing restoration cannot pass.
safety_gate: Confirm physical/verbs/netdev mapping and isolated IB address scope; never modify a management or Ethernet path
Use matching pinned perftest versions/options and a hard external watchdog; do not use unsupervised `--run_infinitely`
Preserve address/route/link/counter/log prestate and maintain alternate management access
Abort on route/address conflict, unexpected port, link/RAS/error/thermal event, UFM mismatch or access loss; terminate both peers and never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Node/netdev/HCA/port/GID/peer/cable identity and pre/post address/route/link state
Perftest versions, exact peer commands, PIDs, watchdog, full outputs and statuses
Endpoint rate/counter time series and UFM port/metric/unit/time-series export
Timestamp/unit normalization and approved tolerance comparison
Real UFM screenshots, clean fabric logs, worker termination, restored state and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On any fault stop client then server through the supervisor, preserve first-failure endpoint/UFM evidence, remove only test addresses/routes, restore captured link/network state and verify both ports plus UFM/fabric health. Do not restart traffic automatically or alter topology.
